node.label: Output
node.description: x + y + a + b + c + d

object.script:
function onTick() x = input.getNumber(1) y = input.getNumber(2)
target_x = input.getNumber(3) target_y = input.getNumber(4)
dx = target_x - x dy = target_y - y
distance = (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) ^ 0.5 azimuth = 90 - math.atan(dy / dx) * 180 / math.pi
if dx < 0 then azimuth = azimuth + 180 end
output.setNumber(1, azimuth) output.setNumber(2, distance / 1000) end

min_charge = 0.5 max_charge = 0.9
clutch = 0 clutch_step = 0.01
function onTick() charge = input.getNumber(1)
if charge < min_charge then clutch = math.min(clutch + clutch_step, 1) else if charge > max_charge then clutch = math.max(clutch - clutch_step, 0) end end
output.setNumber(1, clutch) end
